identificationModule.officialTitle: Single Arm, Two Phase, Multicenter Trial to Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of the CAR-T for Recurrent or Refractory Acute Non T Lymphocyte Leukemia

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a single-arm,multicenter Phase 2 study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of the CAR-T for recurrent or refractory acute non T lymphocyte leukemia.The study will be conducted using a phase I/II design.The study will have the following sequential phases:Part A (screening leukapheresis, cell product preparation, and cytoreductive chemotherapy) and Part B (treatment and follow-up). The follow-up period for each participant is approximately 35 months after the final CAR-T infusion. The total duration of the study is expected to be approximately 3 years. A total of 24 patients may be enrolled over a period of 3 years.

primaryOutcomes.description: The number of complete remission (CR) +The number of complete remission with incomplete hematologic recovery (CRi)/Total number of cases being treated
